pages.title: The Holy Sword
pages.text: Dormant $(6)Holy Swords$(0) are found inside ancient loot chests in $(3)Ancient Cities$(0).$(br2)By bringing a Holy Sword to the $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0) along with relics from the Bovine Dimension, its latent sacred blade arts can be awakened into specialized weapons.$(br2)Each Holy Sword skill features active $(6)Right-Click$(0) techniques with specialized combat utility.

pages.title: Stasis Sword
pages.text: Manipulates local chrono-particles.$(br2)Right-clicking manifests a shimmering stasis bubble around the target area, freezing all hostile entities and incoming projectiles dead in their tracks for several seconds.

pages.title: Split Punch
pages.text: Unleashes a supersonic kinetic shockwave forward in a straight line.$(br2)Enemies caught in the shockwave are launched airborne, while brittle obstacle blocks are cleanly shattered by the kinetic impulse.

pages.title: Crush Punch
pages.text: Strikes the earth with colossal downward gravitational force.$(br2)Creates a localized radial earthquake that stuns all nearby mobs and deals heavy blunt damage scaled against high armor values.

pages.title: Lightning Stab
pages.text: Channels atmospheric ionic potential directly into your target.$(br2)On impact, summons pinpoint celestial thunderbolts that shock the target, pierce armor, and arc secondary sparks to adjacent foes.

pages.title: Holy Explosion
pages.text: Ignites a magnificent dome of radiant sacred light centered on the wielder.$(br2)Deals amplified cleansing damage against undead monsters (Zombies, Skeletons, Withers) while pushing enemies back in an explosive holy wave.
